description: Named variables of the PuppetNurse's behaviour (chara/PuppetNurse/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_pos_x
fields.note: Where the collision shapes were last placed from (the spawn point until the first visible frame).

fields.name: puppet_nurse_push_x
fields.note: The last hit: its push (decays every tick and moves the body) and amount.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_home_x
fields.note: The spawn point the idle wander turns around.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_walk_speed
fields.note: The own walk speed, kept while the push moves the body.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_damage_taken
fields.note: Damage summed since the last stagger.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_alert_timer
fields.note: Keeps the chase going for a while after Harry was heard.

fields.name: puppet_nurse_release_on_free
fields.note: The attack started while the type's group was busy or Harry was held: let go once he is free.
